newsitem.title: USA: TABLE- Jenna Lane Inc Q1 net rises.
newsitem.headline: TABLE- Jenna Lane Inc Q1 net rises.

text.p: Weighted average of common and common equivalent shares
NOTE: The tabulated period pertains to the three months ended June 30 1997 and 1996 respectively.

Income for the first quarter of fiscal 1998 was adversely affected by a $243,500 pre-tax or $0.02 per share after-tax non-recurring provision for credit loss taken as a result of Montgomery Ward's filing for bankruptcy, for which the company had entered into a loss sharing agreement with its factor.
Results for the three months ended June 30, 1996 include $25,000 in non-recurring charges.
The company was taken public March 1997 by Walsh Manning Securities LLC in an offering which raised approximately $6.5 million.
